baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive يُؤْذَنُ and the result-linked فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ make authorization the condition for an attempted excuse.
baseline_models.mechanism: A procedural gate controls whether defensive speech can become an admitted act. The gate stays closed, so the excuse does not enter the hearing as an authorized response.

activation_trace.role: Permission and authorization supply the gate whose closure blocks the consequent defense.
Claiming or receiving an excuse supplies the defensive act seeking removal of blame.

changed_reading.after: Their apology is procedurally disabled because no authorization lets it become an admissible response.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُؤْذَنُ can activate receptive hearing as well as formal permission, while يَعْتَذِرُونَ supplies the plea awaiting reception.
baseline_models.mechanism: The blockage can lie at the receiving end of speech: there is no receptive audience that listens to and accepts the attempted apology.

activation_trace.role: Listening and receptive hearing supply the unavailable receiving channel for the plea.
The excuse supplies speech that seeks acceptance and removal of blame.

changed_reading.before: Permission is only leave for the speakers to begin talking.
changed_reading.after: No hearing opens to receive their plea; denied permission also becomes denied uptake.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The authorization branch of يُؤْذَنُ combines with branches of يَعْتَذِرُونَ that concern vindication and an affair becoming impossible.
baseline_models.mechanism: An apology could try to relocate blame onto another party and thereby vindicate the speaker. With no authorized forum, that transfer cannot be made effective and the attempted vindication does not come right.

activation_trace.role: Authorization supplies the forum needed for a vindicatory claim to have force.
Vindication against another supplies the attempted reassignment of blame.
An affair becoming impossible supplies the failure-state of that vindicatory attempt.

changed_reading.before: They are merely prevented from saying sorry.
changed_reading.after: They cannot make any blame-shifting vindication operative; the defense itself has become impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening communication sequence sends a message, supplies a reminder, and reaches the paired outcome of excuse or warning. The later refusal of permission therefore marks closure after notice has already done its exculpatory and cautionary work, rather than suppression before notice.

activation_trace.role: Permission and authorization supply the response gate that is now closed.
The sought excuse supplies the late defensive response barred by that gate.
Messenger and message supply an earlier outbound channel of communication.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies prior notice rather than informational deprivation.
Going far enough to be excused supplies the completion of the earlier communicative opportunity.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the alternative function already performed by the message.

structural_cues: 77:1-6 forms an ordered movement from sending to reminder to ‘excuse or warning.’
77:36 repeats the excuse root only after that opening provision has run its course.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an opening message-reminder sequence culminates in excuse or warning, while 77:36 denies permission to excuse. Reader arrow: completed prior notice closes the later response window. Live alternative: 77:6 may describe the message's purpose without establishing a procedural deadline.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts an isolated refusal to hear a defense.
changed_reading.after: The defense window closes only after a message has already supplied excuse and warning; the silence is terminal, not pre-notice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Promise, occurrence, appointment, and fixed term create a temporal sequence with an expiry. The denied authorization in the focus ayah belongs to the post-deadline phase: what was announced and deferred has arrived, so defensive speech can no longer alter the event.

activation_trace.role: Authorization supplies the response opportunity whose temporal availability has ended.
The excuse supplies the attempted response arriving after closure.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the scheduled horizon of the promised event.
Falling and becoming established supply the promised event's irreversible arrival.
Fixing a thing by a time or limit supplies a bounded schedule.
A prescribed terminal point supplies the deadline after which the excuse has no procedural time.

structural_cues: 77:7 declares the promised event certain, and 77:11-13 moves from appointment and deferral to the day of separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the event is promised, certain to occur, appointed, and deferred to a fixed day. Reader arrow: these temporal bounds imply expiry of the opportunity represented by permission. Live alternative: the timing may govern only the event, not an earlier opportunity to answer.

changed_reading.before: Permission is withheld as a timeless act of authority.
changed_reading.after: Permission has expired at the appointed terminal phase, when the promised event is already established and cannot be pleaded away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Judicial separation distinguishes truth from falsehood, the repeated label of denial burdens the speakers' credibility, and gathering places all parties in one forum. Against that setting, the focus root's feigned-excuse branch changes the barred apology from generic speech into a defense unable to survive completed truth-sorting.

activation_trace.role: Authorization supplies admissibility in the assembled forum.
A feigned excuse accompanying shortcoming supplies the suspect defensive claim.
A judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the forum's completed evidentiary function.
Contrariety to truth supplies the repeated credibility problem surrounding the speakers.
Joining the dispersed into one assembly supplies the comprehensive hearing setting.

structural_cues: The refrain naming the deniers recurs before and after 77:36.
77:38 explicitly names the day of separation and the gathering of present and former peoples.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repeated denial surrounds the focus, then truth-separating judgment and comprehensive gathering are named. Reader arrow: a late excuse from these speakers is treated as evidentially spent or feigned. Live alternative: the labels identify the speakers but do not independently prove every possible excuse false.

changed_reading.before: Any defense, potentially valid or invalid, is simply denied a turn.
changed_reading.after: The barred defense arrives after truth and falsehood have been separated in a comprehensive assembly, so it has no remaining evidentiary work to do.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated command to proceed activates release and sending, while the focus denies authorization to speak. Agency is therefore selectively controlled rather than globally absent: movement toward consequence is commanded, but defensive discourse is not released.

activation_trace.role: Permission and authorization supply the specific discursive liberty withheld.
The excuse supplies the speech-act kept from release.
Release from constraint and sending supply compelled outward movement toward the denied reality.

structural_cues: 77:29-30 repeats the imperative ‘proceed’ before 77:35-36 removes utterance and authorization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the addressees are twice commanded to proceed, then are not permitted to excuse themselves. Reader arrow: the scene distinguishes compelled bodily motion from withheld discursive agency. Live alternative: the imperatives may stage a transition without asserting a general theory of selective agency.

changed_reading.before: The condemned are simply incapacitated in every respect.
changed_reading.after: They can be sent where judgment directs, but they cannot release self-defensive speech; control is asymmetric, not total immobility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate preceding denial of utterance and the focus denial of permission form two locks: spontaneous articulation does not occur, and no authorized exception opens for defensive speech.

activation_trace.role: Permission and authorization supply the second, institutional lock on speech.
The excuse supplies the particular speech-act for which no exception opens.
Articulate speech supplies the first lock: ordinary utterance itself is absent.

structural_cues: 77:35 and 77:36 are adjacent coordinated negations, moving from not speaking to not being permitted to excuse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: one ayah negates speaking and the next negates permission followed by excuse. Reader arrow: the two clauses describe distinct articulatory and procedural barriers. Live alternative: the second may simply specify the first rather than add an independent barrier.

changed_reading.before: The verse alone closes a procedural opportunity.
changed_reading.after: The scene closes both spontaneous utterance and the authorized defensive exception, producing a double rather than single silence.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, authoritative speech is issued to the same group, yet they refuse the embodied acknowledgment of bowing; the surah ends by asking what renewed discourse they will receive with settled belief. This creates a reciprocal reversal: those who did not receive commanding discourse find no receptive hearing for their own defensive discourse.

activation_trace.role: Receptive hearing supplies the unavailable uptake of their apology.
The excuse supplies the defensive discourse seeking reception.
The production of spoken command supplies the earlier message addressed to them.
Humility and submission supply the embodied acknowledgment they withhold when addressed.
Renewed speech as report or discourse supplies the communicative object they still fail to receive.
Assent that settles the heart supplies the receptive response absent from their side of the exchange.

structural_cues: 77:48 stages speech addressed to them and their refusal to bow.
77:50 closes with a question about any discourse after this receiving their belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: they do not bow when speech addresses them, and the ending questions their belief in any later discourse. Reader arrow: their denied hearing in 77:36 reverses their own failure of receptive response. Live alternative: the later refusals may characterize them without establishing reciprocal measure-for-measure causation.

changed_reading.before: No audience receives their apology, with no account of the reversal.
changed_reading.after: The unavailable hearing answers a larger failed exchange: they withheld receptive submission from addressed discourse, and their own defense now receives no uptake.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the material fading-of-traces branch of the excuse root rather than the ordinary apology sense. It remains anchored in يَعْتَذِرُونَ and is reinforced by context branches for recognition through marks, erasure of traces, and removal from place. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy, not as a lexical translation or a claim that the surah names a culpability record.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ع ذ ر includes a branch in which آثار are effaced, while denied authorization blocks the focus action.

activation_trace.role: Authorization supplies the denied operation by which the incriminating trace might be removed.
Erasure and fading of traces supply the material image for attempted exculpation.
Recognition through an effect or mark supplies the idea that a trace identifies what occurred.
Wiping away a trace supplies the cosmic counter-image of actual effacement.
Uprooting and removal from place intensify the context's material image of obliteration.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they cannot authorize an exculpatory erasure of the trace that identifies their conduct, even amid a scene where cosmic traces and landmarks are erased.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes the focus root as ear and the context as tongue, moving beyond the ordinary permission sense. It remains valid as a branch-backed model of emission and reception anchored in يُؤْذَنُ, with explicit context support from speech and tongue branches. Render it as a communication-circuit analogy only, not as a claim that the ayah anatomically mentions an ear or tongue.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root of يُؤْذَنُ supplies both an ear-like receiver and receptive hearing, allowing the denied permission to be modeled as a closed receiving channel.

activation_trace.role: The physical ear supplies the material receiving endpoint of the analogy.
Receptive hearing supplies the functional uptake that the receiving endpoint would perform.
The excuse supplies the message that cannot traverse the circuit.
Speech supplies the emission action already negated immediately before the focus.
The tongue as instrument of speech supplies the material emitting endpoint.

changed_reading.before: A speaker is denied permission to make a plea.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, both emission and reception are closed: no spoken apology leaves a tongue or reaches an accepting ear.

strongest_changes: The opening message-reminder-excuse-or-warning sequence turns denied permission into terminal closure after notice.
The immediate pairing of no utterance with no authorization creates a double lock on defensive speech.
Appointment, fixed term, and certain occurrence temporalize the closure as an expired response phase.
The later refusal to bow or believe makes the unavailable hearing for apology a reciprocal reversal of failed reception.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet converted a compact speech prohibition into a staged communication system: notice is sent, timed, repeatedly rejected, judicially sorted, and finally closed. It also exposed selective agency and branch-backed material models that a local reading would miss.
remaining_uncertainties: Receptive hearing may coexist with authorization, but it may also be only an associative activation of the same root.
The opening excuse-or-warning sequence supports completed notice, though it does not explicitly state a response deadline.
The compelled-motion distinction and reciprocal reversal depend on reader-supplied causal organization of separated scenes.
The trace-erasure and acoustic-circuit outliers should remain analogical and exploratory rather than lexical renderings.
